claims.summary: The release is grounded in fresh deployed v0.15.166 browser evidence where the package blocked before ZIP while the header foregrounded Quality 100 and Texture 94.
WorkspaceQualityChip now reads the shared package trust status and renders blocked packages as a red review or fix-required state instead of foregrounding a clean-looking score.
Blocked quality chips preserve the deterministic grade and texture in accessible labels/tooltips while naming the export blocker first, including critical P0 counts when present.
proofCommands: rg -n "export blocked by|including .* critical|grade result" src/components/WorkspaceQualityChip.jsx tests/v0143-quality-badge.test.js

claims.summary: The focused regression pins a blocked finish with one blocker, graded 100/A, Texture 94, and no visible clean Quality 100 foreground text.
proofCommands: rg -n "does not foreground a 100/100 grade|Texture 94|not.toContain\('Quality 100'\)" tests/v0143-quality-badge.test.js
